findings.message: 1 line in "Check them now" has no quote from the guideline ("Dial 111 now if they are:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Aged 12 or over" has no quote from the guideline ("The Foundation's poster for ages 12+ differs:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Known allergy" has no quote from the guideline ("The NZ asthma guidance does not cover this."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Not sure it is asthma" has no quote from the guideline ("The NZ asthma guidance does not cover this."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "No reliever inhaler" has no quote from the guideline ("The NZ asthma guidance does not say what to do without a …"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Not breathing" has no quote from the guideline ("The NZ asthma guidance does not say what to do next."). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "The ambulance has arrived" has no quote from the guideline ("Tell them what happened, how many puffs you gave and when…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
The guideline mentions 2 amounts the template never uses: 4 breath, 4 minute. Some may be background; check none were left out.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
